description: This file contains extension methods for the Ninject dependency injection framework, specifically adding functionality to conditionally load modules from assemblies if they haven't been loaded yet.

classes.name: NinjectExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for the Ninject IKernel to enhance module loading capabilities.

methods.name: LoadIfNotLoaded
methods.description: Extension method that loads modules from given assemblies into the kernel if they are not already loaded.
